item.title: Hiruzen Yakisoba: Miso-Sauced Noodles of the Highlands — Guide
item.description: Hiruzen yakisoba is a distinct regional take on Japan’s ubiquitous fried noodles. Instead of the usual dark Worcestershire-style sauce, cooks in the Hiruzen highlands use a rich miso-based sauce blended with garlic, apple and other fruit, giving a sweeter, deeper, slightly nutty flavour. The other signature is the protein: kashiwa, chewy parent chicken rather than pork, along with plenty of local cabbage. Each family and restaurant has its own sauce recipe, and the dish became nationally famous after winning the B-1 Grand Prix, Japan’s contest for regional comfort food, in 2011.
